title: Azure Terraform Infrastructure Input
description: JSON-only Azure infrastructure input. Resource names are generated using {org}-{app}-{env}-{type}-{instance}; Terraform enforces the final Azure name length for each resource type.

subscription_id.title: Azure subscription ID
subscription_id.description: Required Azure subscription GUID. Replace the example placeholder with your subscription ID.

naming.title: Organization-wide naming standard
naming.description: Shared prefix components used by every resource. Generated pattern: {org}-{app}-{env}-{type}-{instance}. The type code is controlled by the platform.

org.title: Organization code
org.description: 2-12 lowercase letters or digits. Keep it short because it is included in every resource name.

app.title: Application/platform code
app.description: 2-16 lowercase letters or digits, optionally separated by single hyphens.

resource_groups.title: Resource groups
resource_groups.description: Each object creates one resource group. Add or remove objects to control the count. Provide an instance value for each resource group.

instance.title: Resource instance identifier
instance.description: 1-40 lowercase letters or digits, optionally separated by single hyphens. The final generated name must also fit the resource type's Azure limit.

resourceGroup.title: Resource group
resourceGroup.description: Generated name: {org}-{app}-{env}-rg-{instance}. Final Azure resource-group name limit: 90 characters.

instance.title: Resource-group instance
instance.description: User-controlled suffix for this resource group. The complete generated name must be 90 characters or fewer.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Optional Azure tags as string key/value pairs.

virtual_network.title: Virtual network (optional)
virtual_network.description: Include only when this resource group needs a VNet. Generated name: {org}-{app}-{env}-vnet-{instance}. Final limit: 64 characters.

instance.title: VNet instance
instance.description: User-controlled VNet instance. The complete generated name must be 64 characters or fewer.

address_space.title: VNet address space
address_space.description: One or more IPv4 CIDR ranges, for example 10.10.0.0/16.

subnets.title: Subnets (optional)
subnets.description: Optional list of subnets. Each has its own instance identifier.

subnet.title: Subnet
subnet.description: Generated name: {org}-{app}-{env}-snet-{instance}. Final Azure subnet name limit: 80 characters.

instance.title: Subnet instance
instance.description: User-controlled subnet instance. The complete generated name must be 80 characters or fewer. Subnet instances must be unique within their VNet.

address_prefixes.title: Subnet address prefixes
address_prefixes.description: One or more CIDR ranges for this subnet. Ensure each range fits within the VNet and does not overlap another subnet.
